items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: Percy loves to have me in these bands, but he don't like to play with me.

ctx.x: That's done with the wrist, you see. While I'm, you see, while I'm picking, I'm easing up on the vibration on the wrist. I mean, that's right. Do you think you ever have, have you ever been better than just that time?

Oh, no, I'm better than I've never been in my life, you see, because I'm more mature. I'm a little tired. I just know, you see. Yeah. And another thing about me, you see, I cannot play my banjo as an old man should. No. That's another thing about me. I say I'm going to go out there and I'm not going to, I'm going to take it easy. But there is no such a thing. You got some musicians can't take it easy. Another one like me was Papa John. That's why he fell dead on the music. Yeah. See, as an old man, 89 years old,…
